FORM NO.
G. 40M-1 35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
C.3.6, Special Branch **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date ____ July 12.. 19 39.

Subject (in full).... IRWIN. M. - Arrival of.

Made by.... D.S. Anderson .... Forwarded by D.S.I. .... **〔此处转录不清〕**

In connection with a teleprinter message,
circulated from Central Police Station at 2.11 p.m. on 21-5-39,
regarding a British seaman named R.Irwin, aged 21 years, being
absent from his ship, the s.s. "Holt Range", I have to report
that, in this office, there is no record of his having been
located.

However, on the 6-7-39 one named R.Irwin, arrived
in Shanghai from North China Ports, on board a Jardine-
Matheson vessel, the s.s. "Wosang" and it is within the bounds
of possibility that the two persons aforementioned may be one
and the same.

No particulars other than the above are available
in this office.

D.S.(Special Branch).

A S Anderson
D. S.

La. to DS cumm.
FILE
P. A. to D C. (Sp. B.)

C.3.6，特别处 **〔此处转录不清〕**
报告
日期 ____ 1939年7月12日。

主题（全称）____ IRWIN, M. - 抵达。

制作人 ____ D.S. Anderson  ____ 转呈人 D.S.I ____  **〔此处转录不清〕**

关于1939年5月21日下午2时11分由中央捕房 circulated 的一份电传消息，内容涉及一名名为 R. Irwin、21岁的英国海员从其所在的“Holt Range”号轮船上失踪一事，兹报告如下：本处并无其被找到的记录。

然而，在1939年7月6日，一名名为 R. Irwin 的人从华北港口乘坐怡和洋行（Jardine-Matheson）的“Wosang”号轮船抵达上海，上述两人有可能是同一人。

本处除上述信息外，无其他详情。

特别处侦探警长 (D.S.)。

A S Anderson
侦探警长 (D. S.)

抄送侦探警长 Cumm.
归档
助理处长致副处长（特别处）

P.A. (Sb.Br.)

8 am 21/5/39 to 8 am 22/5/39.

DAILY REPORT OF IMPORTANT MESSAGES PASSING THROUGH C.C.R.

9.27 am. From R.U.(W). Search parties will move off at 9.30 am.
(Returned at 11.33 am)

1.00 pm. From P.A.Divs. to Officers i/c Stations "A" & "B" Divs.
Telephone to C.C.R. before 4.00 pm a rough figures of
the number of search parties operating on Friday 19/5/
39, number of persons searched and number of lodging
houses etc searched.
(Stations "A" & "B" Divs informed)
(Answer given)

1.05 pm. From GR. At 10.35 am today a male Chinese was held
up on Connaught Rd near Yamping Rd by 3 men 1 armed
with pistol and robbed of a ring value $30.00. No
shots. No arrests. Shanghai dialect.
(Circulated)

2.11 pm. From C. Absent from s.s. "Holt Range" 3 British
seamen (1) A.McKenzie age 37 (2) R.Irwin age 21
and (3) K.Brahy age 18.
(Circulated)

3.02 pm. From BW. Shooting affray reported in progress on
Jessfield Rd near Brenan Rd.
(Circulated)
(Later informed by BW - It was in Chinese territory)

7.27 pm. From R.U.(W). Search parties will move off at 7.30 pm.
(Returned at 9.36 pm)

3.06 am. From Ch Rd. At 12.10 am today a Japanese student
whilst riding in a public ricksha No.unknown was
assaulted and robbed of Yen 100 by the puller and
about 10 other coolies and loafers on Taku Rd near
Mohanwk Rd.
(Circulated)

4.00 am. From C. Step Motor Car No.3484 stolen by armed
robbers at about 3.00 am today. Occupants armed.
(Circulated)

For information :-
Messages received re Japanese
movements on Soochow Creek :- N I L.
20 Ambulance calls.
1 Fire Call.

助理处长（特别处）

1939年5月21日上午8时至1939年5月22日上午8时。

经由中央无线电室（C.C.R.）传递的重要消息日报。

上午9时27分。来自西区巡捕房（R.U.(W)）。搜查队将于上午9时30分出发。（于上午11时33分返回）

下午1时00分。来自警务处各部门。致“A”区及“B”区各捕房主管警官。请于下午4时前电话告知中央无线电室，关于1939年5月19日（星期五）出动的搜查队数量、受搜身人数以及受搜查的寄宿舍等的大致数字。
（已通知“A”区及“B”区各捕房）
（已回复）

下午1时05分。来自总巡捕房（GR.）。今日上午10时35分，一名中国男子在康纳路（Connaught Rd.）靠近延平路（Yamping Rd.）处被三名男子拦截，其中一人持手枪，抢走一枚价值30.00美元的戒指。未开枪。无人被捕。讲上海话。
（已分发通报）

下午2时11分。来自中央捕房（C.）。“Holt Range”号轮船上有三名英国海员失踪：(1) A. McKenzie，37岁；(2) R. Irwin，21岁；(3) K. Brahy，18岁。
（已分发通报）

下午3时02分。来自西区捕房（BW.）。据报在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Rd.）靠近布伦南路（Brenan Rd.）处发生枪击冲突。
（已分发通报）
（后接西区捕房通知——事发地点在中国地界）

晚上7时27分。来自西区巡捕房（R.U.(W)）。搜查队将于晚上7时30分出发。（于晚上9时36分返回）

凌晨3时06分。来自虹口捕房（Ch Rd.）。今日凌晨12时10分，一名日本学生乘坐一辆牌号不详的公共人力车，在大沽路（Taku Rd.）靠近莫赫克路（Mohanwk Rd.）处，遭车夫及约十名其他苦力和闲汉殴打，并被抢走100日元。
（已分发通报）

凌晨4时00分。来自中央捕房（C.）。斯蒂普（Step）牌汽车第3484号于今日凌晨3时左右被武装劫匪盗走。车内乘客持有武器。
（已分发通报）

供参考：
收到关于苏州河上日本人动向的消息：无。
救护车出警20次。
火警呼叫1次。
